name: browser-use
headline: Haflow - AI Mission Orchestrator for Coding Agents
short_description: Haflow is a local-first AI mission orchestrator for operations teams. It enables launching, monitoring, and approving coding agent missions in real-time. Connects to Claude Code agents for local development cycles.
author: oxedom

sections.overview:
Haflow is a fullstack webapp control panel that lets operations teams launch, monitor, and approve Claude Code agent missions directly from a browser dashboard. Agent steps run in isolated Docker containers, providing real-time visibility into mission progress. The web-based interface enables team collaboration, mobile access via Tailscale, and remote deployment options. Teams can observe shared missions, set human approval gates, and manage the entire agent workflow lifecycle from a single pane of glass. Haflow integrates with local development cycles and supports scaling across Docker infrastructure.
Monitor Claude Code agent progress in real-time from a centralized dashboard
Establish human approval gates for critical agent outputs before execution
Enable remote team visibility and collaboration on shared agent missions
Manage containerized agent workflows across local and VPS environments
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/oxedom/haflow`
sections.usage:
```
I'm using Haflow to manage a mission for [COMPANY] in the [INDUSTRY] sector. I need to launch a mission to [DESCRIBE TASK] using [DATA] or [SPECIFIC TOOLS]. Can you guide me through setting this up in Haflow?
```
Copy

```
# Mission Setup for [COMPANY] Data Analysis
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
```
